decisions.reason: Its upgrade from a simple mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests performance above aspiration for a complementary floor-care line, so we would keep it.

Because it remained only mentioned rather than more strongly promoted, its results likely sit around or a bit below aspiration, but as an adjacent maintenance product in an established firm it is still worth keeping for now.
The move to a page of its own indicates improving acceptance and a fit with the firm’s flooring-related portfolio, which supports keeping it.

This underlay stayed in the catalogue without stronger visibility, implying only moderate evidence of success, yet it remains close to the core flooring business and does not warrant immediate withdrawal.

High-density underlay foam appears to have weaker revealed momentum than the products that gained dedicated pages, but organisational slack and portfolio fit support retaining it another year while results remain uncertain.
An oak parquet floor is highly consistent with the firm’s established wood-products capabilities, so even without a stronger website signal we would keep it unless clearer underperformance emerges.
